highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.150.4 corrects GPU glyph-atlas tracking and shared stencil-clear coordinates.

bullets.detail: Prevents a partial glyph-vector regeneration from marking earlier, potentially evicted glyph locations as current.

bullets.lead: Shared stencil attachments use native coordinates
bullets.detail: Tracks stencil clears in backend-native coordinates when render targets with different surface origins share an attachment.

Corrects the compiler-warning configuration that caused BinSkim BA2007 failures in applications consuming HarfBuzzSharp.NativeAssets.Win32. Native exports and shaping behavior are unchanged; other existing BinSkim warnings are unaffected.

harfbuzz_summary: Windows native assets correct the warning configuration that triggered BinSkim BA2007. HarfBuzz remains at native version 14.2.1 with unchanged shaping behavior and exports.

v4.150.4.headline: SkiaSharp 4.150.4 corrects glyph-atlas reuse and shared stencil tracking.
v4.150.4.body: Windows HarfBuzz native assets also stop triggering the BinSkim BA2007 disabled-warnings error.
